lunch.name: Mapo Tofu (Spicy Tofu in Sauce)
lunch.description: Sichuan classic - soft tofu in spicy sauce with ground pork. Name means pockmarked old woman who invented it
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Cut tofu into cubes, set aside
Heat oil, add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute
Add pork, break up and cook until no pink
Stir in doubanjiang, cook 1 minute
Add soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, Sichuan peppercorns and broth
Bring to simmer, add tofu gently
Simmer 5 minutes
Add cornstarch slurry to thicken
Serve immediately with rice
lunch.notes: Handle tofu gently to avoid breaking. Sichuan peppercorns create numbing sensation
lunch.fun_fact: Mapo Tofu is Sichuan classic, name means pockmarked old woman who invented it. One of Eight Great Traditions of Chinese cuisine

dinner.name: Mapo Tofu (Spicy Soft Tofu in Numbing Meat Sauce)
dinner.description: Soft tofu in numbing and spicy meat sauce - Sichuan dinner classic
ingredients: 400g silken or soft tofu, cut into cubes
1/2 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
Add ground pork; stir-fry until no longer pink (3-4 minutes); remove
Add doubanjiang and chili oil; fry 1-2 minutes until fragrant and oil turns red
Add fermented black beans, garlic, ginger; stir-fry 1 minute
Return pork to wok
Add soy sauce, sugar, stock; bring to boil
Gently add tofu cubes; simmer 3-4 minutes
Add ground Sichuan peppercorns
Stir cornstarch mixture; pour into wok
Stir gently until sauce thickens (1-2 minutes)
Drizzle sesame oil; garnish with scallion
Serve immediately with white rice
dinner.notes: Numbing sensation from peppercorns is essential

dinner.name: Kung Pao Chicken (Spicy Stir-Fry with Peanuts)
dinner.description: Sichuan stir-fry with chicken, peanuts, and chilies - balanced heat
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil in small bowl (sauce)
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or large skillet over high heat
Add chicken cubes, stir-fry until cooked through (5-7 minutes), remove
Add chili oil to wok
Add dried chilies, cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds
Add onion and red pepper, stir-fry 2 minutes
Return chicken to wok
Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables
Add peanuts and ground Sichuan peppercorns
Stir cornstarch mixture into ingredients
Stir constantly until sauce thickens (1-2 minutes)
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with scallions
Serve immediately over steamed rice
dinner.notes: The Sichuan peppercorns create unique numbing sensation - essential for authentic flavor
dinner.fun_fact: Kung Pao Chicken was reportedly created for Ding Baozhen, a Chinese official in the Qing Dynasty
alternatives: Adjust heat with different chili amounts
